rationale: The last five 5-minute candles show extremely thin participation (100–500 shares each) with a near-zero effective range, signaling the instrument has become illiquid and potentially locked — making reliable entry and exit highly uncertain. The bid-ask spread of 81 bps is punishing relative to the compressed ATR of $0.04, meaning slippage alone could consume a meaningful portion of any expected move. With no news catalyst, no sector/float context, and the price already extended ~45% above session VWAP after a large gap, there is no identifiable mechanical edge to justify a directional bet in either direction.
